title: Lottie LED Lightbox Sign, 4500K Neutral White - White
description: Lottie is an illuminated lightbox sign with a 3mm opal acrylic face, aluminium frame, and 4500K LED panel. The 4500K colour temperature is neutral cool-white — not the yellow warmth of an older backlit sign, and not the harsh blue of cheap LEDs. It's the light that makes text and logos read clearly at any hour. Five-sided illumination means the light is even across the face with no hot spots. Keyhole bracket wall mounting. Plug-in power — no electrician required. Order blank or with your artwork applied in vinyl before shipping.

title: Henry Aluminium Sliding Sign for Glass Doors and Windows - White
description: Henry is a powdercoated aluminium open/closed sign with a sliding panel mechanism. Slide it one way and OPEN faces out. Slide it the other and CLOSED takes over. It mounts to glass doors, shop windows, timber doors, or any flat wall surface with adhesive tape — no drilling required. Suitable for interior and exterior use. It's a simple product that solves a specific problem: most open/closed signs look cheap, and the good-looking ones are either too large, too delicate, or impossible to find. Henry is none of those things.
